title: Metro Cebu air quality still ‘unhealthy for sensitive groups’ on October 8

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Metro Cebu’s air quality remained in the “unhealthy for sensitive groups” category on Thursday, October 8, as the Environmental Management Bureau Region 7 (EMB-7) continued to monitor elevated air pollution in the area. EMB-7 has attributed the recent deterioration to local emissions and meteorological conditions, rather than transboundary pollution from Indonesian forest fires. At 7 a.m. on Thursday, the Metro Cebu Station recorded an air quality index (AQI) of 134, classified as “unhealthy for sensitive groups.” Explainer: Why is Metro Cebu’s air quality fluctuating?
